title: Overture
body:
# Overture

![A photo of a Minecraft player using Overture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73c898730b64b7d25d08cd6a6f83d84d11819f37.png)

Overly customizable playing media overlay

## Features

- System API fetching
  - Other sources can be added in the future
  - Currently Windows & Linux support
- Tons of visual customization
- Configurable polling intervals & modes
  - Includes "smart checking", which means Overture will only check for new songs after the current one is supposed to be over, or on the default interval if tabbed out.
- Off-thread fetching (so lag spikes shouldn't be an issue)


## Notes

- Direct Spotify integration has been omitted due to [recent changes requiring Premium for access to the Web API](https://developer.spotify.com/blog/2026-02-06-update-on-developer-access-and-platform-security)
  - Feel free to ask for any further integrations
- macOS is not supported at the moment; I don't have access to a device that runs it
